First test release. Change your voice live in Discord, games, OBS or Zoom, record it, or give existing audio files a new voice.

## Download

- **VoiceChanger-Setup-0.1.0.exe** (recommended): installs for your Windows account only, with no administrator prompt. Adds a Start menu entry and an uninstaller, and can start with Windows if you tick that box.
- **VoiceChanger-0.1.0-portable.zip**: nothing to install. Unzip it anywhere and run `voicechanger.exe`.

**"Windows protected your PC"?** This build isn't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen warns about it. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

## Get started

1. Install [VB-CABLE](https://vb-audio.com/Cable/) (free). It's the virtual microphone other apps listen to. Voice Changer walks you through it if it's missing.
2. Open Voice Changer, pick your microphone and press **Start**.
3. In Discord, your game or OBS, choose **CABLE Output** as the microphone.
4. Click a voice. Tick **Hear myself** (with headphones) to listen.

## What's in it

- 17 voices (Deep, Female, Robot, Monster, Auto-tune, ...), fine-tune sliders, randomize and undo, and your own saved voices.
- Effects: noise suppression, noise gate, pitch and formant, robot, voice character, EQ, compressor, reverb, radio.
- Fake a **bad mic or bad connection** (cheap headset, laggy Wi-Fi, tunnel, broken cable), with a "Glitch now" button.
- Global hotkeys (also mouse side buttons), a tray icon and on-screen toasts.
- **Record** what the virtual mic sends, and **process audio files** with your voice (WAV or MP3, optional speed change).
- Low CPU use: every effect at once costs about 3 % of one laptop core.

## Known limits

- Early build. So far it has only been tested on one laptop with its built-in mic, not yet with VB-CABLE in Discord or games.
- Hotkeys don't work while an app running as administrator is focused (the app tells you when this happens).
- Toasts don't show over exclusive-fullscreen games (borderless and windowed are fine).
- MP3 needs Windows' Media Feature Pack on "N" editions. WAV always works.

## Feedback

Found a problem? In Voice Changer, go to **Advanced → Help & diagnostics → Copy diagnostics**, then paste it into a [new issue](https://github.com/FlameDevil1/VoiceChangerProject/issues/new).
